gloss: foil; supporting role that makes others look better

definitions.gloss: foil; person or thing that makes another look better by contrast
definitions.explanation: A person, character, or element whose purpose is to highlight or enhance the qualities of another, often the main figure. Equivalent to a 'foil' or 'straight man' in English.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I always end up being the foil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}だ。
examples.english: The supporting actor is a foil for the lead.

examples.japanese: ⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧な⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}になっている。
examples.english: The simple dress serves as a foil to highlight her accessories.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく} comes from ⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧ (to make something stand out) + ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role). It can refer to people, characters, or even objects that enhance something else by contrast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become a foil
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be made into a foil (passive, slightly negative)
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ — to take on the foil role

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧ — to make something stand out
- ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧ — supporting role
- ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧ — lead role
